The stated purpose is supply chain internalization, including securing a stake in the BNSI nickel smelter in Indonesia and additional investment in its Hungary subsidiary. However, amid a prolonged downturn in the electric vehicle industry, the market reacted immediately to concerns over shareholder value dilution and share overhang. The stock closed down 6.88% at 132,700 won the day after the announcement, after plunging to as low as 123,000 won during the session. Securities analysts also took a negative view of the large-scale fundraising at a time when an industry recovery remains uncertain, forecasting that a short-term share price correction is inevitable.
